newsitem.title: USA: TranSwitch sees Q3 below last year's.
newsitem.headline: TranSwitch sees Q3 below last year's.

text.p: TranSwitch Corp said on Friday revenues and earnings for the third quarter ending Sept 30 would be below those of the third quarter in 1995.

The company said in a statement that the main factor affecting the revenue and the earnings is that "the inventory corrections at telecom and datacom customers have continued for a period longer than expected."
The company reported a loss of $469,000, or $0.04 a share, on revenues of $4.5 million in 1995's third quarter.

"In spite of this current difficult condition in our business, we remain confident of the fundamentals of our business and we feel that the opportunities for our products remain as exciting as before," said Santanu Das, president and chief executive.
